UserPromptSubmit.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.agentarium/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${AGENTARIUM_ROOT}/scripts/controller.ts" prompt vscode

PreToolUse.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.agentarium/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${AGENTARIUM_ROOT}/scripts/blinkers.ts" guard vscode

PostToolUse.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.agentarium/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${AGENTARIUM_ROOT}/scripts/till.ts" tool vscode

Stop.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.agentarium/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${AGENTARIUM_ROOT}/scripts/till.ts" finalize vscode
